name: sloping-walls-simple
description: Simple ladder for sloping (variable-height) walls (slopingWalls, SweetHome3DJS parity). Verifies the flag is OFF in Simple / ON in Pro; that the wall inspector shows the sloped-top fields in Pro; loads a custom plan (PlanShell), gives a wall a sloped top, and screenshots the 3D prism render.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-flag-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: slopingWalls should be OFF in Simple mode (pro-tier)

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: slopingWalls should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: verify-slope-field
steps.failMessage: sloped-top inspector field not shown for a selected wall in Pro mode

waitFor.store: (() => { const w = state.floorPlan.walls.find(w => w.id === window.__wallId); return !!w && w.topHeightEnd === 1.0; })()
